title: CrankMagic Commander Experience
hold_note: Outcome 11 (Oathbreaker and Standard) is held until Rob says the initial launch is 100% done.

outcomes.title: Play any deck legal in Commander in the Play screen

milestones.name: Rob's six live decks, every card proven
Any legal list seats, or the lobby names what cannot and why

outcomes.launch_line: A legal list pasted from anywhere seats at a table with every card playable, or the lobby names the exact cards that cannot and why; the six live decks have per-card regression coverage.

outcomes.title: The game in Play is an exceptional Commander play experience
outcomes.launch_line: Four humans play a full Commander game from invitation to result on desktop and phone: one header and Camera, clear priority and stack, Draw card, source-selection payment, shared combat, Yield turn, the 3D table with the chosen design, music; the game has its name.

outcomes.title: Managing my library is seamless, easy to follow, and fast

milestones.name: Find anything in one gesture, understand it at a glance

outcomes.launch_line: Cards are added by paste, photo or scan in seconds; one search finds any card, box or deck; every row says where the card is in plain words; measured fast on a phone at 10,000 lots.

outcomes.title: Creating Commander decks is fast and reasonable from my criteria
outcomes.launch_line: Playstyle, budget, bracket, optional commander and colors in; a legal, on-budget, compliant hundred out in seconds with a reason per slot; measured against reference decks.

outcomes.title: Tuning a deck is comprehensive and ordered: solid simulations, composition, synergies and chains

milestones.name: One ordered tuning flow on the deck page
Synergies and chains inside the deck

outcomes.launch_line: One Tune tab walks measure, composition, synergies, swaps, re-measure; every number has its variance; every swap its evidence; the simulator and the rules engine agree where they overlap.

outcomes.title: Buying cards balances speed, print and cost by my priorities

milestones.name: One order across decks, arrival to the right box
Prices fresh and shown with their age

outcomes.launch_line: A priority dial reorders the buy list by speed, print or cost; one order across decks; arrivals go to the right box; prices dated and refreshed on a schedule.

outcomes.title: CrankMagic tailored to me: deck and play preferences, aesthetics, information complexity

milestones.name: Deck and play preferences the app reads
Aesthetics: themes, mats, tables, backgrounds, sound

outcomes.launch_line: Deck and play preferences saved once and honored by the builder, the advisor and the table; the look chosen by its look; an information dial every screen honors; all of it traveling with the account.

outcomes.title: AI in action: play strategies and SWOT, coaching, upgrade identification, card resolution

milestones.name: The AI door open and metered

outcomes.launch_line: Every signed-in player can ask for a deck's strategy and SWOT, coaching at the table, upgrades with evidence, and card resolution; every answer labeled, sourced and under Rob's caps.

outcomes.title: Easily share deck builds with others

milestones.name: One Share action on every deck
Public deck page and import from a link

outcomes.launch_line: One Share action on every deck (link, email, text, QR) with permissions in plain words; a public deck page; import from a link; mail delivery observable.

outcomes.title: A joyful experience end to end: create, tune, play, acquire, manage
outcomes.launch_line: A first-time player goes from an empty library to a first game in under ten minutes; every journey has test cases and budgets; instrumentation and operations are in place; the launch checklist is ticked with evidence.

outcomes.title: Oathbreaker and Standard too (held until the initial launch is 100% done)
outcomes.launch_line: Not part of the initial launch. Only the format field on decks and tables is allowed before Rob lifts the hold.
